name: MeisterTask
description: MeisterTask is a visual work-management platform for planning and coordinating tasks across teams. It organizes projects into customizable boards with tasks, checklists, comments, files, timelines, time tracking, automations, reports, roles, and shared notes.
agentUseSummary: Connect a MeisterTask account once, then choose which agents can read or manage its authorized projects and work under Safe or Dangerous policy.

capabilities.label: Read MeisterTask work
capabilities.description: Read authorized projects, sections, tasks, people, checklists, comments, attachments, labels, custom fields, memberships, settings, timelines, and time records.

capabilities.label: Manage MeisterTask work
capabilities.description: Create, update, upload, organize, share, subscribe, track time, and delete authorized work through documented routes.

allowed.label: Read MeisterTask
allowed.description: Read bounded resources from the connected MeisterTask account.

approvalRequired.label: Manage MeisterTask
approvalRequired.description: Create, update, upload, organize, share, subscribe, track time, or delete authorized work.

blocked.label: Expose credentials
blocked.description: OAuth credentials never enter agent-visible requests or results.

blocked.label: Use another API origin
blocked.description: Every request stays on MeisterTask's documented HTTPS API origin.

blocked.label: Call an unsupported API family
blocked.description: Relay permits only documented MeisterTask resource families under /api.

blocked.label: Run an unbounded transfer
blocked.description: Relay bounds queries, files, request bodies, responses, redirects, and execution time.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Reads run directly. Every provider mutation requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected action authorized by the connected MeisterTask account runs without Relay per-action approval. Provider authority, fixed origin, request bounds, credential protection, and audits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts bounded MeisterTask API tools and attaches the OAuth token server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: A signed-in Meister account must register the Relay Console OAuth application and supply its production client ID and secret before one-click connection can be verified.
providerSetup.nextAction: Register Relay Console at https://www.mindmeister.com/api with https://api.relayconsole.work/api/v1/marketplace/oauth/meistertask/callback and the userinfo.profile, userinfo.email, and meistertask scopes; store MEISTERTASK_CLIENT_ID and MEISTERTASK_CLIENT_SECRET in Railway, deploy, and verify connect, identity, reads, Safe approval, Dangerous mutation and upload, revocation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: MeisterTask documents authorization-code OAuth through Meister's application system, bearer access tokens, personal tokens for one-off use, and the userinfo.profile, userinfo.email, and meistertask scopes.

The official documentation indexes projects, sections, tasks, people, checklists, comments, attachments, labels, custom fields, memberships, settings, timelines, work intervals, groups, and their documented read and mutation endpoints.
Meister's application system documents self-service OAuth client registration with one or more redirect URIs and issues a client ID and secret.

Meister documents the confidential authorization-code flow, exact authorization and token endpoints, ten-minute one-use codes, form-encoded exchange, and access tokens that may be non-expiring until manually revoked.
MeisterTask describes its work-management product and currently lists full API use on Pro, Business, and Enterprise plans rather than Free.
